manifest.name: @sherl98/dsh-orca-ocean
manifest.description: A dynamic pure-ASCII background of a cruising orca for the new-session page; after the first prompt, it dives Into the Unknown.
manifest.author: sherl98

readme.text:
中文 | [English](README.en.md)

**让一头 ASCII 虎鲸游进你的 DeepSeek Harness。**

纯ASCII代码构成的虎鲸游弋动态背景，仅在新会话页面中生效。发出第一句提示词后，虎鲸将下潜深度求索。

[观看完整录屏](assets/demo.mp4)

| 浅色模式 | 深色模式 |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

演示环境：DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3`（macOS）。

兼容 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` 及后续 `0.2.x` 版本。

在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的 **插件 → 添加插件** 中输入：

```text
github:sherl98/dsh-orca-ocean
```

Web / CLI 用户运行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sherl98/dsh-orca-ocean
```

按宿主提示启用或重启，然后打开新会话。自动适配浅色与深色模式，遵循系统的「减少动态效果」设置。

卸载：在插件页面移除，或运行 `dsh plugin --profile web remove @sherl98/dsh-orca-ocean`。
修改 `client.template.js` 或 `mask.json` 后运行 `npm run build`，生成随仓库分发的 `client.js`。运行时无需安装额外依赖。

[中文](README.md) | English

**Let an ASCII orca swim into your DeepSeek Harness.**

A dynamic pure-ASCII background of a cruising orca, active only on the new-session page. After the first prompt is sent, the orca dives Into the Unknown.

[Watch the full recording](assets/demo.mp4)

| Light mode | Dark mode |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

Demo environment: DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` on macOS.

Compatible with DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` and later `0.2.x` releases.

In DeepSeek Harness Desktop, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter:

```text
github:sherl98/dsh-orca-ocean
```

For Web / CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sherl98/dsh-orca-ocean
```

Enable or restart as prompted, then open a new session. Adapts to light and dark mode and respects your system's reduced-motion setting.

To uninstall, remove it from the Plugins page or run `dsh plugin --profile web remove @sherl98/dsh-orca-ocean`.
After editing `client.template.js` or `mask.json`, run `npm run build` to regenerate the bundled `client.js`. No extra runtime dependencies are needed.
